mechanism_narrative: A strong increase in GDP growth rate indicates a robust economy, leading to higher consumer spending and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during periods of strong GDP growth (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the federal funds rate below 1.5% triggers an increase in borrowing and spending, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 5-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: An increase in the unemployment rate above 4% indicates a slowing economy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods of high unemployment (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production indicates a strong economy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during periods of strong industrial production (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: The interaction between GDP growth rate and consumer spending indicates a robust economy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during periods of strong GDP growth and consumer spending (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: The interaction between the federal funds rate and inflation rate indicates a monetary policy response, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 5-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate below 3.5% indicates a strong labor market, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days, but only during periods of monetary easing.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during periods of low unemployment and monetary easing (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: An increase in housing starts indicates a strong economy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days, but only during periods of economic expansion.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during periods of strong housing starts and economic expansion (t-test p > 0.05).
